title: PeopleSoft Studio's page writer replays App Designer's captured saves: every replay test passes
statement: src/test/pageWriter.test.ts rebuilds App Designer's captured saves (HRDMO, PeopleTools 8.62.09) through Studio's page writer and requires App Designer's rows and counters; every top-level test passed in the recorded run. Evidence about Studio, not PeopleSoft (rule 3); it says nothing about releases not captured. docs/PAGE_SAVE.md lists the cases.

observations.observation: Run of src/test/pageWriter.test.ts (node:test, TAP): 50 top-level tests, all passed.

testResults.name: a move writes only the moved control's position columns (03-move shape)
a resize writes RIGHT/BOTTOM and FIELDSIZETYPE (04-resize shape)
a label change writes LBLTYPE and LBLTEXT (05-label shape)
use changes write FIELDUSE and SECUREINVISIBLE (09-property shape)
rebinding a control writes RECNAME / FIELDNAME, and only what changed (Record tab)
toggling Allow Deferred Processing writes DEFERPROC (default 1)
a Grid / Scroll Area Options tab writes OCCURSCOUNT1 and the grid display flags
a delete removes the row and renumbers the survivors (08-delete shape)
no change yields no updates
an existing control not on the stored page is refused (an added one carries `add`)
an added control takes MAXPNLFLDID + 1 and is numbered after the survivors (02-add-edit shape)
deleted ids are never reused: adds start above the high-water mark
a blank label sent as '' is the stored ' ', not a change (and is written as ' ')
page properties write only what changed, as App Designer stores it (19-props-descr shape)
a new page size writes PANELRIGHT/BOTTOM and makes the Page Size choice Custom (14-props-use shape)
the Order tab's order renumbers FIELDNUM; an order that is not the page's is refused
a reorder across a grid or scroll takes the level of its new place; one that empties a scroll is refused
the captured General / Use settings plan exactly App Designer's columns (g01, u01-u05)
blank names are stored as ' '; unchanged settings plan nothing
page type and a secondary page's options plan exactly App Designer's columns (u08-u12)
a secondary page sized Custom keeps its button bits (0x08 with 0x01 / 0x02 as they were)
Fluid Page and the Fluid tab plan exactly App Designer's columns (u13, f01-f06, u14)
a tab order change writes only the moved controls' FIELDNUM (o01)
a paste copies its source's rows, moved by the paste offset, after the source in tab order (c02)
a pasted auto-sized Edit Box: its 0 RIGHT moves too, its hidden label does not (c01); onto another page (n01)
New Page: App Designer's fresh PSPNLDEFN row (n01); a writer-created page carries LICENSE_CODE ' '
New Page Fluid: the Layout Page's row, renamed, standard, Owner ID blank (n02 from PSL_APPS_CONTENT)
every page type change plans exactly App Designer's columns (t01-t11, r01-r06)
each Page Size choice plans exactly App Designer's columns (s01-s08)
a frame's Properties dialog: each setting plans exactly App Designer's columns (fr01-fr07)
a changed Page Field Name must be free on the page; names already stored are left alone
a frame's Fluid tab: each setting plans exactly App Designer's columns (fr08-fr20)
Static Text / Static Image / Check Box single-column property edits plan exactly App Designer's columns
Static Text Paragraph and Static Image dims use the right ext/geometry columns
Static Text line feeds and Multi-Currency on a Fluid page plan exactly App Designer's columns (st11)
a pasted copy's rows carry the level the save planned; without one, the source's level
an added control takes the tab order App Designer gives it: after the control before it in reading order
a Group Box's dialog settings plan exactly App Designer's columns (gb02-gb27; gb08 was a full snapshot without PSPNLFIELDEXT, its bit recurs in gb09)
OK on a Group Box's dialog writes App Designer's explicit Left, FIELDUSETMP 0x6000000 and five Fluid slots; -1 Header Extension on a Fluid page only
a Horizontal Rule's dialog plans exactly App Designer's columns (hr02-hr06), and its OK writes the five Fluid slots on any page (hr01, hr07)
a Check Box's dialog plans exactly App Designer's columns (cbx02-cbx17)
an HTML Area's dialog plans exactly App Designer's columns and PSPNLHTMLAREA row (ha01-ha10)
a Long Edit Box's dialog plans exactly App Designer's columns and PSPTPNLRTEDITOR row (le01-le19)
an Edit Box's dialog plans exactly App Designer's columns (eb01-eb82)
scroll levels: App Designer's level changes, Set to Level and reorders replay exactly (lv04, lv06, lv08-lv16)
added controls take App Designer's tab order and level: a scroll at 1, the rest the running level (lv02, lv03, lv05, lv07)
a field dropped in a grid is its next column, at (0, 0), and the grid counts it (gd-column, ts-fresh)
a grid added with its column counts it (ag-fresh); a Tab Separator outside a grid is refused
a grid whose stored count does not follow the (0, 0) rule keeps it (Fluid grids nesting group boxes)
a Tree's TREECTRLID follows its FIELDNUM, with its levels; a deleted tree's levels go (sp-fresh, sb-delete)
